sequence: Conventional proofs, then Lean build/axiom audit, then implement and execute this protocol

rate_baselines: numerical full-moment optimum on its exact finite interval
raw_flat.moment_method: six-code flat ODE; analytical prior threshold classifies infeasible rates before solving; optimization is floating diagnostic, not a new certificate
checks: reuse/recheck prior exact rational C enclosure
closed-form new absolute threshold vs quadrature

bounded_sampling.additional_wave_state: x=1.5*T, the moving front with exact u=-0.5, so long-time accuracy cannot be explained solely by saturation near -1
bounded_sampling.tree: full untruncated ternary Brownian tree, shared child birth position; no depth/node truncation, no outlier removal, complete each prescheduled root
bounded_sampling.leaf: phi at Brownian terminal position; conditional expectation of spin votes
outputs: all root values and node counts
expected node count (3 exp(2 rate T)-1)/2
bounded_sampling.uncertainty: bounded iid roots give radius sqrt(2 log(2/alpha)/N) for exact arithmetic; simultaneous intervals use alpha divided by number of scheduled rows; floating evaluation error is not enclosed
bounded_sampling.cost: compare node costs and variance times expected nodes; do not claim runtime/variance superiority against raw trees across invalid moment regimes

raw_sampling_diagnostic.policy: raw uniform with existing exact-zero-code pruning
raw_sampling_diagnostic.purpose: show why small empirical variance cannot certify integrability; record overflow rather than discard it
raw_sampling_diagnostic.confidence: no normal confidence coverage claims in infinite-variance/nonintegrable regimes

resource_rules.estimated_budget: tens of millions of nodes, minutes of CPU; batch independent roots for bounded memory
resource_rules.on_budget_problem: record failed scheduled configuration and amend transparently before rerunning; never drop a difficult tree while keeping easy roots
resource_rules.retained_failures: all test/verification failures and substantive protocol amendments recorded
